<b>Tallcraw Jurors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are lanky, elder [[Craws|crawbugs]] who summon Hornet in service of a sacred ceremony.<ref>Tallcraw Juror [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Elder crawbug serving in a sacred ceremony." "Curiosity saw me answer their summons, but I shall not allow them to stall me long."</i></ref> They are the [[Act 3]] counterparts to [[Tallcraw]]s, with slightly more health, a slightly lower damage modifier, a changed attack, and an immunity to needle-bounce attacks.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Tallcraw Jurors behave identically to their weaker counterparts, either flapping in the air or hopping around on the ground, preparing for an attack. They occasionally switch between their grounded and aerial states, which each have different attacks.

The Tallcraw Jurors have 5 attacks that are all identical to the [[Tallcraw]]s', except for one:

* <b>Jab:</b> Performs a short jab at Hornet.
* <b>Dash:</b> Raises its pin before performing a long dash at Hornet, covering much more area.
* <b>Arcing Slashes:</b> The Tallcraw hops into the air, spinning its pin around itself repeatedly. This attack CANNOT Combo Hornet, which makes getting hit by it less threatening.
* <b>Aerial Jab:</b> The Tallcraw flies to a point over Hornet before pointing its pin downwards, trying to drop down on top of her.
* <b>Aerial Dash:</b> The Tallcraw raises its pin towards Hornet before dashing straight at her, bouncing off the first surface it hits. The angle of the dash is not static and changes so they go in a straight line towards Hornet.


Tallcraw Jurors' metal headwear provides them with a special Immunity to needle-bounce attacks on their whole bodies.

== Location ==
Tallcraw Jurors can be found exclusively in [[Greymoor]] during the [[Court of Craws]] fight in the [[Craw Lake]] building.
